description: This file contains the handler for editing a booking location, including functions for updating location in connected apps, database, and sending notifications, as well as related helper classes and types.

classes.name: UserError
classes.description: Error class for user-facing errors related to location handling.

classes.name: SystemError
classes.description: Error class for system/internal errors related to location handling.

methods.name: updateLocationInConnectedAppForBooking
methods.description: Updates the booking location in external connected applications and handles errors if update fails.

methods.name: extractAdditionalInformation
methods.description: Extracts additional event information such as hangout link and conference data from update results.

methods.name: updateBookingLocationInDb
methods.description: Updates the booking location and related metadata in the database.

methods.name: getAllCredentialsIncludeServiceAccountKey
methods.description: Fetches user credentials including service account keys, validating access for conference credentials.

methods.name: getLocationInEvtFormatOrThrow
methods.description: Determines the event format location, throwing errors if default conferencing app info is missing or invalid.

methods.name: getLocationForOrganizerDefaultConferencingAppInEvtFormat
methods.description: Generates the location URL or identifier for the organizer's default conferencing app, with error handling.

methods.name: editLocationHandler
methods.description: Main handler function for editing a booking's location, coordinating updates, notifications, and audit logging.
